title: Email/query: invalid limit type silently coerced to no-limit
description: email.rs:169-172: 'Some(v) => v.as_u64()' returns None if limit is a float, string, or negative integer. limit=None is then passed to the backend (no-collapse path) meaning all results are returned. A client passing limit=10.0 or limit='10' expects a page of 10 but gets everything. RFC 8620 §5.5 says limit is UnsignedInt|null — invalid type should return invalidArguments.
